timing.coverage: all templates exactly once by validated static group layout

tolerance_policy.finite: all complex samples and all numeric trigger fields
tolerance_policy.pointwise_acceptance: every normalized complex sample versus independent oracle AND standard MKL reference; every row sigmasq versus independent oracle
tolerance_policy.raw_complex_v1_audit: diagnostic only; original R3 verdicts remain unchanged

sources.normalized_complex_snr: DRAFT extension of existing absolute trigger-SNR budget 1e-3 to every complex sample; independent oracle and MKL compatibility both required; adoption is a separate decision
sources.oracle: NumPy complex128 product of captured complex64 inputs, unnormalized np.fft.ifft*N; sigma=4*df*sum((bank.real64**2+bank.imag64**2)/PSD64)
sources.pointwise_complex: predeclared campaign policy rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-6; not a repository-test tolerance
